location.address: 7001 Stan Roberts Sr, El Paso, TX 79934
location.site_description: Approximately 1,000-1,038.948 acres in Northeast El Paso, on the north side of Stan Roberts Sr. Avenue, west of U.S. Highway 54.

actions.government_body: City of El Paso City Council
actions.notes: City approved the Meta/Wurldwide LLC agreement package in December 2023.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.action_type: construction start date in TABS registration
actions.notes: TABS2026017750 lists Project Seafox new construction at 7001 Stan Roberts Sr with 12 buildings, 5 owner substations, and site work on approximately 600 acres.

actions.result_status: existing Meta project already under construction
actions.notes: City release states the existing Meta project is already under construction while policy framework outreach continues.
Meta and BlackRock announced a venture to develop and own the El Paso campus, expected to begin bringing capacity online in 2028.

capacity_basis: Meta describes the campus as having 1 gigawatt of compute capacity; this is not independently confirmed as grid interconnection load.
owner: Meta / BlackRock venture; Wurldwide LLC listed as TDLR project owner; Meta to be initial sole occupant

ownership_details.tenant: Meta is expected to lease and use the entire campus as initial sole occupant.

tdlr_project.scope: 12 new buildings, 5 owner substations, and site work on approximately 600 acres.

water.meta_restoration_commitment: Meta says it will restore 200% of water consumed by the El Paso data center to local watersheds.

power.city_confirmed_generation_review: City says filings for generation units are under PUCT review and the electric utility is seeking approval for a 366 MW McCloud natural-gas installation.

project_details.online_target: Meta says the venture expects to begin bringing capacity online in 2028.

sources.match_reason: Official City, TDLR, and Meta sources now verify the seed record as the Meta/Wurldwide LLC El Paso campus.

contradictions.details: City resource hub still describes the project as a $1.5B infrastructure development, while Meta's July 2026 announcement says over $10B from Meta and approximately $14B total development costs for the venture. The City's draft policy framework also cites approximately $10B.

City resource hub lists approximately 1,800 construction jobs and at least 50 permanent roles; Meta's July 2026 announcement lists more than 4,000 construction jobs at peak, 300 operational jobs, and over 2,300 workers already onsite.
